record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: If X is a generic set of q points in P^{n-1}, is the defining ideal of X generated in degree one more than the least degree d for which the Hilbert function of X equals q?

artifact.category_tag: Ideals of generic points, Hilbert functions
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, and let $S = k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be the standard graded polynomial ring, viewed as the homogeneous coordinate ring of $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$. For a finite set of points $X \subseteq \mathbb{P}^{n-1}$, let $I_X \subseteq S$ denote its (saturated) homogeneous defining ideal, and let $H_X(t) = \dim_k (S/I_X)_t$ denote its Hilbert function. A set $X$ of $q$ points in $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$ is said to be in generic (general) position when $H_X(t) = \min\{\binom{t+n-1}{n-1},\, q\}$ for every $t \ge 0$. Define $d = d(q,n)$ to be the least nonnegative integer such that $H_X(d) = q$, equivalently the smallest degree in which the Hilbert function attains its eventual value $q$.

Question (Ideal Generation Conjecture): For a generic set $X$ of $q$ points in $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$, is the homogeneous ideal $I_X$ minimally generated in degrees $d$ and $d+1$ only? Equivalently, are all minimal generators of $I_X$ of degree at most $d+1$?
artifact.status_search_result: The Ideal Generation Conjecture for generic points in projective space is known in some cases and open in general. It has been proved for points in $\mathbb{P}^2$, for many values of $q$ in $\mathbb{P}^3$ (including specific cases such as 28 points in $\mathbb{P}^3$ by Ballico–Geramita), and follows from the Minimal Resolution Conjecture where the latter is known. The Minimal Resolution Conjecture (which implies the Ideal Generation Conjecture) is known to fail for sufficiently many points in $\mathbb{P}^n$ with $n \ge 6$ (Eisenbud–Popescu), but counterexamples to the Ideal Generation Conjecture itself are not established in general, and the conjecture remains open in many cases.

status_evidence.title: The Ideal Generation Conjecture for 28 Points in P3
status_evidence.snippet: Resolves a specific case of the Ideal Generation Conjecture for 28 points in P^3.
status_evidence.claim: Specific cases of the Ideal Generation Conjecture have been established.

status_evidence.title: The Minimal Resolution Conjecture on a General Quartic Surface in P3
status_evidence.snippet: The Ideal Generation Conjecture is a consequence of the Minimal Resolution Conjecture; for general points in P^2 and P^3 partial results are available.
status_evidence.claim: The Ideal Generation Conjecture is a special case of the Minimal Resolution Conjecture and is partially known.

status_evidence.title: On the defining ideal of a set of points in multi-projective space
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses degrees of generators for ideals of generic points and conjectured behavior.
status_evidence.claim: Generic point configurations and the degrees of their ideal generators are an active topic.
